description: 15 officers complete a digital university programme
body_lead: The Kerala Police have developed a specialised team for crime detection through artificial intelligence (AI). Fifteen police officers have completed a capacity building programme in AI and data analytics conducted by Digital University Kerala (DUK). Announcing that the AI team of the Kerala Police had become operational, Inspector General of Police (South Zone) P. Prakash said the team would apply their newly acquired skills in policing with immediate effect.
